task_description: Elementwise y = x*scale + bias over a (1024, 128) bf16 array via pltpu.emit_pipeline: input buffer_count=2 versus buffer_count=3.

metrics.name: dma_wait_fraction
metrics.description: Fraction of kernel time spent waiting on DMA. The difference between variants appears only when per-block DMA latency exceeds per-block compute time. Requires a profiler trace.

notes: buffer_count > 2 is supported on input BlockSpecs only; on an output BlockSpec it raises NotImplementedError. pl.Buffered(..., use_lookahead=True) allows prefetching further ahead.
